# Amber opening pocket summary

This pocket card was condensed before revision C. It is not maintained as a controlling procedure. The [current handbook](firing-handbook.md) takes precedence.

## Door reminder
The old classroom shorthand says wait until 70 synthetic degrees and inspect the latch. It omits the independent probe and timed interval and must not be substituted for the complete current cooling release section.

## Card stock
Print exercises on grey stock and stamp them TRAINING. The pocket format was chosen for a classroom exercise, not to eliminate required observations.
